title: Move the city and timezone beside the send button
description:
"New York City · Eastern time" used to close the Contact section, below the profile list and above a 96px gap to the footer. That placement gave it two problems: it read as a footnote to the social list rather than as a statement about the section, and it sat roughly 700px below the send button — while the question it answers, when will she see this, is one the reader asks at the moment of deciding to send.

It now sits on the send button's own row. SubmitRow already rendered an empty slot beside the button for an authored reply note that content never filled (`form.reply` is null), so the place line fills a designed-but-empty slot and removes the orphaned line in the same change. It stays inside Contact rather than moving to the footer, which is a nav bar and signoff and would have had to do two jobs.

Two layout consequences were handled. The button is now `flex: none; white-space: nowrap`, because as a shrinkable flex item sharing the row it broke its label across two lines ("Send / note") on a phone; and `.foot` wraps, so on a narrow screen the place drops beneath the button instead of squeezing it. Verified one line at every width from 320px up with no horizontal overflow, and Send note still clears the fold everywhere it did before.

Renaming SubmitRow's `reply` prop to `place` renamed its isolation scenario key, which left the registered `submitrow-noreply` scenario pointing at a key the page no longer defines — it was capturing an "Unknown scenario" error page while reporting a successful capture. Replaced with `submitrow-noplace`, and all 71 scenario URLs were then swept for the same failure; none remained.
